as_told.title: Mario Woods hears 'do not fear' during abduction
as_told.place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

plain: A man named Mario Woods, speaking on a podcast episode about UFOs and nuclear weapons bases, says that sometime in the 1960s in South Dakota he had an encounter with beings who were not human. He says he kept hearing the same message over and over: "do not fear." If true, it would mean whatever he met was trying to calm him and talk to him.
